crossRefs.note: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with…
He asked them to provide animals, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
“This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them, when I came with the soldiers and rescued him…
They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and…
Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t…
I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
translations.bsb: Immediately he took some soldiers and centurions and ran down to the crowd. When the people saw the commander and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
translations.kjv: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
translations.asv: And forthwith he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down upon them: and they, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, left off beating Paul.
